description_en: Queries the status of created real-time speech-to-text or translation tasks
description_zh: 查询当前已创建的实时语音转文字或翻译任务的状态信息
kebab_example: aliyun live query-rtc-asr-tasks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id asr-a6ac15e0-9118-4b4c-9e64-306163a00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryRtcAsrTasks

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task to query. If you do not specify this parameter, all running tasks under your user ID are queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的任务ID，不填写则查询用户uid下所有运行中的任务
parameters.name: task_id
